reviews.title: Great goggles
reviews.body: Googles work great! The seal is incredible and the earplugs are very convenient so you don’t get water in your ears. My sisters loved them and they work for kids and adults. My brother had a pair similar to these and the clamp broke, but I was somewhat rough so that was my fault. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Amazing goggles!!
reviews.body: These are amazing! Sunglasses and goggles in one. My son is 12 and they fit both of our faces. Plus the added earplugs and nose plug are awesome if you are trying to keep water out of your ears and nose!

reviews.title: Excellent product
reviews.body: These goggles are the future of goggles!  No more eye marks, make a nice seal to your face, and protect your eyes from sun rays.  So far they've been durable enough to withstand my kids!  I'm buying more for myself!

reviews.author: p stark

reviews.title: Surprisingly awesome
reviews.body: Grabbed these as a casual pair of goggles for our ocean and pool excursions, and honestly loved them way more than I expected. The quality felt solid, and I especially loved having the ear plugs and nose plugs in the ocean. I could float around without worrying about where the next wave was going to hit. They were great in the pool too. The polarized lenses helped with the sun, and overall, I would definitely recommend them.
